claude_proposed_widenings.name: GrantSpellAccessEffect (ClassFeatureEffect)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Mystic Arcanum grants a chosen spell that can be cast without expending a spell slot, using a dedicated use_count resource that resets on Long Rest. No ClassFeatureEffect variant currently models 'grant access to a chosen spell with a slot-free use count'. The v4 atom grant_spell_access exists in the taxonomy (§9 Effect Atoms) but is absent from the ClassFeatureEffect union in types.ts.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can cast your arcanum spell once without expending a spell slot, and you must finish a Long Rest before you can cast it in this way again.

discrepancies: no content/warlock_mystic_arcanum_l11.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
